body: Rotkäppchen-Mum: manages sales & retail execution
We shape the digital future of your brand – collaboratively, with innovation, and at eye level.
We are industry experts in consumer goods and support companies in their digital transformation along the entire value chain.

As an experienced partner for consumer goods companies, we combine analysis, consulting, and system integration into a holistic approach. With our comprehensive SAP expertise and innovative, data-driven technologies, we create seamless and flexible end-to-end processes that future-proof your business.

Our service portfolio goes beyond modern Data and CX solutions to include integrated planning in all its facets – from corporate and demand planning to account and promotion planning. As part of the Reply Group, we also leverage our deep AI expertise to optimize your processes, always with the goal of strengthening your brand and delivering an outstanding customer experience.
years of experience
completed projects
experts in our network
Inspire your B2B customers with excellent experiences in sales and service, and create sustainable customer relationships.
With connected data, scalable architecture, and targeted analyses, you gain insightful insights and create relevant brand experiences
With customized solutions and detailed data analyses, you create the foundation for quick, transparent, and precise decisions.
4brands Reply supports companies with industry-specific solutions to deliver the right products at the right time and at the right price to the right customers.

A central sales platform connects customer and product data, campaigns, field sales management and current signals from stores. This enables activities to be planned more precisely, implemented more consistently and evaluated more quickly.
By integrating its app, website, and online shop, the mineral water brand is systematically expanding its digital consumer dialogue.

With a creative summer campaign, one of Germany’s most renowned beer brands has found a way to turn emotional engagement into strategic insight, combining memorable experiences with valuable data on consumer behavior and brand loyalty.

During the European Football Championship, the Bitburger brewery group is relying on a comprehensive omnichannel campaign that focuses on direct contact with fans. This is made possible by a pioneering solution from 4brands Reply.

In-keeping with the well-known slogan “Quality in a Square", the family-owned company, together with 4brands Reply, is setting its sights on digital and future-oriented sales with the SAP Sales Cloud.

The elegant bottles in the sparkling wine cellars of Rotkaeppchen-Mumm Sektkellereien represent a unique success story for the leader in the German sparkling wine market. To help maintain its position, the company has replaced its previous CRM solution with the leading consumer goods customer management and mobility software platform implemented by 4brands Reply.

Zentis achieves automation and transparency to better calculate pricing models for customers. Complex pricing models were creating excessive work and complexity for the sales and account teams at Zentis, driving it to identify an optimised IT solution. SAP Business Warehouse provides a homogeneous database that simulates conditional scenarios to support Zentis in...

For Peter Kölln GmbH & Co. KGaA an inaccurate raw material planning is now a thing of the past. 4brands Reply has developed for the former Köllnflockenwerke a smart solution for multi-stage production planning based on SAP APO.
Gold Partnership driven by Innovation, Quality and Success.

The PAC RADAR recognizes Reply as ‘Best in Class’ in Europe for ‘SAP Business AI and Joule-related Services’ and ‘SAP Consulting & Systems Integration,’ confirming our proven expertise in driving the intelligent enterprise.
Reply is proud to announce its recognition in Forrester’s SAP Services Landscape.

The PAC RADAR by teknowlogy is a tool for holistic evaluation and visual positioning of software and ICT service providers on local markets. The PAC RADAR "Leading Providers of SAP Services in Germany 2022" rates Reply as "Best in Class" provider for SAP CX-related services and as "Excellent" for SAP S/4 HANA-related services.

Raise sales potential with real-time perfect store analytics & on-demand retail execution with smartREX. The FMCG-tailored solution from 4brands Reply is now available on SAP® Store, the online marketplace for SAP and partner offerings.
In this webinar series, the experts from 4brands Reply show you the potential of value generation using modern, data-driven and holistic sales planning applications for key account management.

Digital change creates opportunities, but also new requirements and challenges. In these knowledge sharing sessions Reply presents SAP’s cloud solutions for current requirements. Reply experts explain how to make business, data, contact and communication with customers more efficient using AI and cloud solutions from SAP.

Reply leverages Data and Analytics to gain insights into the development of the Coronavirus pandemic and how it impacts society, consumers and industries. This report focusses on the changes in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector since the beginning of the COVID-19 outbreak.
At SAP KonsumKompass 2027, 4brands Reply and Bitburger show how first-party data, marketing automation, and AI enable personalized consumer journeys and digital brand experiences.

Together with Ritter Sport, 4brands Reply will present at the LZ AI Day 2026 how AI and AI agents support data-driven decisions in Revenue Growth Management and unlock new potential for growth and profitability.
From SAP automation and intelligent knowledge management to AI-powered marketing, resource planning and consumer goods – discover how Reply turns AI into concrete business solutions.

4brands Reply and HiPP jointly demonstrate how “HiPP One” was developed as an international digital platform for consistent customer experiences, centralized customer data, and personalized customer communication.
